# Recpad / 렉패드

> A free, ad-free local practice recorder with no account and no upload.
> Record a guitar or practice take from the mic, see the waveform, select a
> region to trim or cut, clean noise with an on-device spectral gate, apply
> gain or normalize to -1 dB, undo mistakes, download as WAV or MP3, and keep
> drafts on this device.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://recpad.try-dabble.com/
Recording, noise clean, gain and export all run inside the browser tab on
this device. Audio is never sent to a server. No accounts, no sign-in, no
uploads, no server storage, no analytics, no ads, no in-app purchases, no
subscription.

## Pages

- [Home](https://recpad.try-dabble.com/): The recorder
- [Privacy](https://recpad.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://recpad.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/en/guides/recpad): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Big Record / Stop button; browser speech-style noise suppression and auto gain are switched off so instruments come through as they are
- Waveform with playhead; drag to select a region, tap to seek, drag an edge to adjust
- Trim to selection, cut selection, clear selection, undo (several levels)
- Noise clean: spectral gate built from the quietest frames of the take, three strengths, computed on this device
- Gain in dB and normalize to about -1 dB
- Export WAV (16-bit PCM) and MP3 (128 kbps, encoded in the tab)
- Drafts on this device: save, open, rename, delete; they survive a refresh
- Demo take so every edit can be tried without a microphone
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
